sections.title: ADMISSION SUMMARY
sections.content:
Dear Doctor,
 Thank you for your ongoing care of [patient], a [age]-year-old F/M who presented to the [department] at [hospital] on [date] with <CIT id="c1">chronic lower back pain</CIT>.
 The primary diagnosis is <CIT id="c11">degenerative spinal changes</CIT> with <CIT id="c12">sciatica</CIT>. The patient reported <CIT id="c2">bilateral lower back pain</CIT> with <CIT id="c3">radicular left leg pain</CIT> shooting to the toes and occasional toe numbness, which <CIT id="c4">flares when standing</CIT>. Relevant past medical history includes <CIT id="c5">Meningitis</CIT> and <CIT id="c6">Hip OA</CIT>.
 On examination, the patient appeared well and mobilising independently. Key findings included a <CIT id="c9">positive straight leg raise on the left lower limb</CIT> and <CIT id="c10">pain flares with left ankle dorsiflexion</CIT>. No midline spinal or paraspinal tenderness, erythema, or back swelling was noted. Neurological examination of the lower limbs revealed normal tone, 5/5 power in all domains, intact fine touch sensation, and present reflexes with downgoing Babinski.
 Treatment provided included <CIT id="c14">analgesia</CIT>. The patient was discharged as stable, with a plan for further investigations and specialist follow-up.

sections.title: DISCHARGE PLAN
sections.content:
1. Discharge destination: Discharge home with wife.
2. Medications: Please continue <CIT id="c7">Vitamins</CIT> and <CIT id="c8">Magnesium</CIT> as prescribed. No new medications prescribed at discharge.
3. Follow-up arrangements:
    *   Complete <CIT id="c13">XR</CIT> as scheduled.
    *   Attend <CIT id="c15">LBP clinic</CIT> appointment as arranged.
    *   Proceed with <CIT id="c16">MRI pending end of April</CIT> as previously arranged by GP.
4. Safety netting: Please seek medical attention and/or present to your nearest emergency department if you experience:
    *   Worsening pain despite analgesia
    *   New or worsening weakness in legs
    *   New numbness or tingling
    *   Loss of bowel or bladder control
    *   Fever or chills
    *   Unexplained weight loss
Kind Regards, Dr [Physician], [Department] [Position]
